title: Locked OOT ROC-AUC by registered cell
population: 66 primary-cohort registered cells across three locked OOT populations: 54 numeric, 12 unavailable
uncertainty: Intervals absent unless registered in the comparison table
interpretation: Performance varies by dataset and model; unavailable cells remain grey crosses.
limitation: Point estimates do not establish superiority.

title: DEV mean versus locked OOT ROC-AUC
population: 124 identities with numeric DEV means; locked OOT populations n=120,053, 293,105, and 304,916
uncertainty: DEV fold SD is tabulated, not used as OOT uncertainty
limitation: DEV folds are not independent datasets.

title: Locked OOT minus DEV mean AUC
limitation: Missing cells are NA, not zero.

title: Locked OOT maximum KS
uncertainty: None; frozen decision thresholds are in the companion table
limitation: Maximum KS is threshold-free in value; operational metrics use the frozen threshold.

title: LLM-assisted effect versus matching mRMR
uncertainty: 95% paired bootstrap intervals only where registered; Holm marker
interpretation: Effects include positive, negative, and inconclusive evidence.
limitation: Original two-dataset rows are low-power fold diagnostics, not OOT inference.

title: Holm-adjusted significance
interpretation: Non-significance is common and is not equivalence.
limitation: NA is unavailable, never p=1 or zero effect.

title: DEV-referenced OOT score PSI
population: 54 cells with authenticated DEV OOF and OOT score PSI
limitation: 0.10/0.25 bands are not drawn because their role differs across cohorts.

title: Type-aware selected-feature PSI
interpretation: Predictor drift need not align with AUC change.
limitation: Feature universes differ; compare within dataset.

title: Fold selection stability
population: 58 method/model summaries with authenticated fold selection sets
interpretation: Stable selection is distinct from predictive performance.
limitation: Only available fold sets enter each summary.

title: Within-dataset method overlap
population: 456 within-dataset/model pairwise final-selection records; figure shows the protocol-fixed LR subset

title: Runtime and peak RAM
interpretation: LLM/hybrid resource cost is not uniform.
limitation: Per-cell RAM is unavailable for some cohorts; crosses are NA.

title: Performance versus runtime
interpretation: Trade-offs, not a universal winner, are visible.

title: LLM incremental AUC
population: 12 registered LLM/stable-core versus matching mRMR identities (12 numeric)
limitation: Third benchmark shares Home Credit lineage.

title: Cross-dataset common-method ranks
population: Up to 18 common method/dataset/model identities: mRMR, LLM, and stable-core
limitation: Ranks omit methods without common coverage and are descriptive.

title: Protocol-fixed OOT ROC curves
population: 18 saved-prediction curves over locked OOT populations n=120,053, 293,105, and 304,916
interpretation: Curve shape supports the tabulated AUC evidence.
limitation: Subset fixed by method role, not observed performance.

title: Protocol-fixed OOT calibration
population: Same 18 saved-prediction curves; ten quantile bins per curve

title: Protocol-fixed OOT score distributions
population: Same 18 saved-prediction curves across three locked OOT populations
interpretation: Methods differ in score spread and location.
limitation: Density shape is not a performance test.
